title: 第463章 比赛结束第462章 你很奇怪
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
“再也没人愿意跟你战斗了，格雷维斯，”女皇略带恼怒地传来信息。“上次只有那头狼愿意跟你战斗，现在恐怕没人愿意跟你战斗了。”
格雷维斯闻言，皱了皱眉。“好吧，不过，这附近还有没有其他出色的五级领主？我的确需要磨练一下。”他问道。
皇后又叹了口气，用手指揉了揉鼻梁。“你为什么这么想磨炼自己？我不明白。你还没准备好学习新的法门，却还要拿自己的性命去冒险，究竟是为了什么？”她问道。
“嗯，”格雷维斯回答道。“你看到那个让我第一个对手速度减慢的气场了吗？”他问道。
皇后点了点头。
“这股气息，唯有拼命才能凝聚。它之所以能对高我一个等级的凶兽，有如此强的压制力，是因为我已经淬炼了不少。如果不继续淬炼，迟早会变得没用。”
皇后沉默了一会儿，思考着格雷维斯刚才说的话。“我没听说过这种事，不过你的能力本来就很奇怪。你有什么打算？为什么现在要淬炼自己？”
“好吧，只要我再提升一些，或许四级领主就能赢国王了，”格雷维斯承认道，“如果我现在不提升，就得等到五级领主才能和一级国王对战了。”
不知为何，皇后又叹了口气。格雷维斯不明白她为何会有这样的反应。
“格拉维斯，”她传音道，“就算你的怪异气息再强，你也绝对敌不过一个一级王者。想想看，这次活动中，最杰出的五级领主都能与比自己高两级的王者战斗，却没有一个人敢说自己能与一个一级王者战斗，而理论上，一级王者比他们高两级。这是为什么呢？”
格拉维斯不明白为什么。他见识过五级领主的天赋，都知道能够大幅提升战力的法则，为什么他们无法与一级王者对抗？
“其实我不知道，”格雷维斯传讯道。“我对上界知之甚少，因为红王是我见过的第一个国王。显然，因为我们的关系，他什么也没告诉我。”
皇后闻言，微微一愣。“你没有受过任何帝国或王国的指导吗？”她问道。
她之所以如此惊讶，是因为格雷维斯的战斗力和战斗经验，对于一只从未受过任何引导的野兽来说，实在是太强大了。格雷维斯难道没有更强大的野兽指引，就能拥有如此强大的力量吗？这几乎不可能。
格雷维斯摇摇头。“不，我身边只有领主，这些领主要么是我的朋友，要么是我的下属。”格雷维斯解释道。
现在，女皇明白了很多事情。格雷维斯的怪异行为和信任问题现在也说得通了。毕竟，他只有下属和敌人。“你曾经加入过别人的部落或王国吗？”
格雷维斯摇了摇头。“不。我曾经加入的唯一部落是我自己创建的。当然，那个部落已经不存在了。”
女皇对于格拉维斯毁灭的部落毫无疑问。部落每天都来来去去。敌人入侵一个部落，将其彻底消灭，只留下一个部落首领活下来的事件时有发生。
女皇没有继续说话，而是看向其他野兽。数百名国王和领主仍在等着她采取行动。他们看着女皇、白猿和格拉维斯三人站在那里，面面相觑。
这些畜生当然知道他们在说话，只是不知道他们在说什么，只要皇后不下令，它们就一直站在那里等着。

“我稍后会向你解释一些事情。首先，我需要结束这件事，”女皇对格拉维斯说。
然后，她转向在场的国王和领主们。“比赛结束了，”她宣布。“格雷维斯将成为我的伴侣。”
在场的野兽们对此毫不意外。格拉维斯已经证明了自己的实力，他被选中也是理所当然。野兽们很少有这种特权感，所以他们也就接受了这件事。他们的候选人只是实力不够而已。
“所有候选人都将加入我的帝国。国王们都将获得标准奖励。大长老已注意到你们的贡献，并将永远铭记你们。”女皇宣布道。
content_en:
"No one wants to fight you anymore, Graves," the Queen messaged with a hint of annoyance. "Only that wolf was willing to fight you last time, but I'm afraid no one is willing to fight you now."
Graves frowned when he heard this. "Okay, but are there any other outstanding fifth-level lords around here? I really need to hone my skills." He asked.
The Queen sighed again and rubbed the bridge of her nose with her fingers. "Why do you want to train yourself so much? I don't understand. You are not ready to learn new skills, but you still want to risk your life. Why?" she asked.
"Yeah," Graves replied. "Did you see that aura that slowed down my first opponent?" he asked.
The queen nodded.
"This aura can only be condensed by working hard. The reason why it has such strong suppressive power against ferocious beasts that are one level above me is because I have tempered it a lot. If I don't continue to temper it, it will become useless sooner or later."
The queen was silent for a while, thinking about what Graves had just said. "I have never heard of such a thing, but your ability is very strange. What are your plans? Why do you need to temper yourself now?"
"Well, as long as I improve a little more, maybe the fourth-level lord can beat the king," Graves admitted. "If I don't improve now, I will have to wait until the fifth-level lord can fight against the first-level king."
For some reason, the queen sighed again. Graves didn't understand why she reacted this way.
"Gravis," she said via voice, "no matter how strong your weird aura is, you will never be able to defeat a first-level king. Think about it, in this event, the most outstanding fifth-level lords can fight against kings two levels higher than themselves, but no one dares to say that they can fight a first-level king. In theory, a first-level king is two levels higher than them. Why is this?"
Gravis didn't understand why. He has seen the talents of the fifth-level lords and knows the rules that can greatly increase their combat power. Why can't they fight against the first-level kings?
"Actually I don't know," Graves relayed. "I know very little about the Upper Realm, as the Red King was the first king I ever met. Apparently, because of our relationship, he told me nothing."
When the queen heard this, she was slightly startled. "Have you not been guided by any empire or kingdom?" she asked.
The reason why she was so surprised was that Graves' combat power and combat experience were too powerful for a beast that had never received any guidance. Could Graves be so powerful without the guidance of a more powerful beast? It's almost impossible.
Graves shook his head. "No, I only have lords around me. These lords are either my friends or my subordinates." Graves explained.
Now, the Queen understands many things. Graves' weird behavior and trust issues also make sense now. After all, he only has subordinates and enemies. "Have you ever joined someone else's tribe or kingdom?"
Graves shook his head. "No. The only tribe I've ever been a member of was one I created myself. Of course, that tribe no longer exists."
The Queen has no doubts about the tribe Graves destroyed. Tribes come and go every day. It often happens that an enemy invades a tribe and completely wipes it out, leaving only a tribal leader alive.
The Queen did not continue speaking, but looked at the other beasts. Hundreds of kings and lords were still waiting for her to take action. They looked at the Queen, White Ape and Gravis standing there, looking at each other.
Of course these beasts knew they were talking, but they just didn't know what they were talking about. As long as the queen didn't give an order, they kept standing there waiting.
"I'll explain something to you later. First, I need to end this," the Empress told Gravesexplain.
Then she turned to the kings and lords present. "The game is over," she announced. "Graves will be my companion."
The beasts present were not surprised by this. Graves has proven his ability and it is natural for him to be selected. Beasts rarely have this sense of privilege, so they just accept it. Their candidates just weren't strong enough.
"All candidates will join my empire. Kings will receive standard rewards. Your contributions have been noted by the Grand Elder and you will be remembered forever," the Queen announced.
